question_text: If 3 more than twice a number is 19, what is the number?

hint_ladder.title: I-translate sa math
hint_ladder.text: Let x = number of eggs. 'Twice' means 2x, '3 more than' means +3, 'is 19' means =19.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you divided 19 by 2 first, then subtracted 3, getting 6.5 and rounding down.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you mistakenly used 5 instead of 3, doing (19-5)/2 = 7.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you read '3 more' as '1 more,' doing (19-1)/2 = 9.

next_time_rule: Kapag may 'more than,' unahin ang addition. Translation: 'twice' = 2x, 'more than' = +, 'is' =. Solve equation.
deconstruct_text:
Alam mo 'yung feeling pag bumibili ng itlog sa palengke tapos nagbigay ng bugtong si Aling Nena? Ganito 'yan: Hayaan mong x ang bilang ng itlog.

'Twice the number' o doble ng bilang ay 2x. Tapos '3 more than' ibig sabihin ay dinadagdagan ng 3, kaya 2x + 3. Ang sabi, 'is 19', kaya equation: 2x + 3 = 19.

Solve natin: Ibawas ang 3 sa magkabilang panig — 2x = 16. Saka divide both sides by 2: x = 8. Ibig sabihin, 8 itlog ang binili mo.

I-check: Doble ng 8 ay 16, dagdagan ng 3 ay 19. Sakto!
